label: FP
reason: The vulnerable parameter 'bar' is assigned from a conditional block that only executes if a mathematical condition is met. Since the condition (500 / 42) + num > 200 is always false (as 500/42 ≈ 11.9 and adding 196 gives 207.9 which is greater than 200), the 'else' branch is taken, assigning 'This should never happen' to 'bar'. This makes the actual value used in the response fixed and non-user controlled.

evidence.note: The conditional logic ensures 'bar' gets a fixed value instead of the user-provided input.
